_comment: THE VEIL - the one place that numbers the story chapters (displayed numbers). A chapter has begun once ANY of its `start` flags is set; the current chapter is the highest one begun, so existing saves get the right number from their flags without any migration. Internal ids (flags, objective ids, chapterN.gd file names) are NOT renumbered: `impl` names the code that plays each chapter.
